key.name: font-family
key.description: CSS font-family list used for the clock digits. Comma-separated; the first family available on the system wins.

key.name: font-weight
key.description: Pango/CSS numeric font weight: 400 regular, 500 medium, 700 bold.

key.name: size-percent
key.description: Font size as a percentage of the monitor's long side. 15% gives 288 px on a 1920 px long side, in both landscape and portrait.

key.name: color-on-dark
key.description: CSS colour used when the system colour scheme prefers dark.

key.name: color-on-light
key.description: CSS colour used when the system colour scheme prefers light.

key.name: only-vendors
key.description: EDID panel vendor codes (for example SAM, BNQ) to show clocks on. An empty list shows the clock on every monitor.

key.name: hide-on-primary-with-windows
key.summary: Hide on the primary monitor with windows
key.description: Hide the clock on the primary monitor while it has any windows.
